Please note: Decorated Mixed Pine garland is not included. At 50cm, this festive wreath is the perfect size for hanging onto front doors and placing over mantelpieces. A sight to behold all in itself, this wreath really doesn’t need anything else to make it magical (although a few extra Christmas LEDs do offer an extra dose of fairy dust!) Accessories shown in the images are not included with the item. The product is sold without any accessories. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

zk6tn7c5.sourceDescription: This Modern Christmas Tree Skirt is the ideal seasonal decor piece, exuding simplicity and functionality synonymous with modern style. With its round shape and woven texture, it adds a unique touch to any tree, enhancing its presence in your living room or on your garden terrace. Perfect for those who cherish subtle elegance, this product seamlessly blends with other decorations while concealing unsightly tree stands. Stylish Modern Look Characterized by its clean lines and minimal ornamentation, the Modern Christmas Tree Skirt elevates the decor of your tree with a chic and contemporary edge. It provides a polished base to showcase the beautifully decorated limbs, adding depth and interest to your seasonal display. The simplicity of this skirt complements a variety of tree themes, from traditional to avant-garde. Woven Texture Made with a carefully woven plastic that mimics natural weaving techniques, the texture of this tree skirt adds dimension and visual interest. Its design not only enhances the aesthetic appeal of your tree but also contributes to its durability, allowing it to withstand repeated use season after season without losing its allure. Versatile Usage Suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor settings, the tree skirt can be placed in living rooms or on patios, lending its elegance to any area. Whether it's under a twinkling Christmas tree or beside a cozy fireplace, this skirt adds warmth and character to its surroundings, being a versatile addition to your holiday decor collection. Durability Crafted from high-quality plastic, the tree skirt boasts a long-lasting build that resists wear and tear, ensuring many seasons of enjoyment. The material choice provides weather resistance, crucial for protected outdoor placements, while the handmade aspect ensures each piece is crafted with care and precision. Easy Assembly With straightforward assembly instructions provided, setting up and storing away your tree skirt becomes an easy task. This design minimizes the time spent on preparation, giving you more opportunity to enjoy your holiday theming and the festive atmosphere your tree brings. Product Specifications Colour: Red Material: Plastic Overall dimensions: 65 x 65 x 24 cm (L x W x H) Maximum tree stand size: 65 cm Top size: 55 Durable Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Delivery-contains: 1xChristmastreeskirt Assembly required: Yes This christmas tree skirt is designed solely for domestic holiday decoration and floor protection. To prevent severe fire hazards or property damage, never allow the fabric to come into direct contact with open flames, hot candles, or exposed electrical wiring from holiday lights. Inspect all tree light strands for frayed cords before placing them near the skirt. Ensure the skirt is laid completely flat around the base of the tree stand to avoid creating a dangerous tripping hazard for residents or guests. Do not block access to water reservoirs on live trees. This seasonal textile product is not a toy; keep all decorative ties, metallic trim, small sequins, and plastic packaging completely out of the reach of infants, small children, and pets. Manufacturer Name: WALPLUS Address: Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingdom Contact: customer.service@walplus.com
